_comment: Mutiny, step by step. scripts/crew.gd grows the unrest (a ringleader recruiting the discontented); these events are the warning signs and the captain's answers. 'priority' with a cooldown: each stage keeps coming back until it's dealt with. See docs/events.md.

unrest_grumbling.title: Grumbling
unrest_grumbling.text: The talk in the forecastle stops when you come forward. Men look at their boots. Somebody is stirring them up, and the crew's mood is sour.

choices.text: Pay what's owed, now
choices.result: Coin in hand quiets most of it.

choices.text: Double the rum for a week
choices.result: Rum and songs. For a while.

choices.text: Ask your officers who's behind it
choices.result: Your quartermaster knows exactly who it is.

choices.text: Ignore it: sailors always grumble
choices.result: It goes on behind your back.

unrest_informer.title: A name
unrest_informer.text: {informant} catches you alone by the taffrail. 'You should know who's been talking against you, Captain.'

choices.text: Listen
choices.result: You have a name now.

choices.text: Send them away: you won't have informers
choices.result: {informant} goes, puzzled and a little hurt.

unrest_round_robin.title: A round robin
unrest_round_robin.text: A paper is nailed to the mainmast: the crew's grievances, signed in a circle so no one name stands first. Shares, pay, the way the ship is run.

choices.text: Meet their demands
choices.result: A bigger share and back pay. They cheer you, and the ringleader loses the audience.

choices.text: Promise to put things right at the next port
choices.result: They believe you. Be sure to keep it: pay what's owed within the month.

choices.text: Tear it down in front of them
choices.result: Nobody steps forward to own it.
choices.fail_result: They watch you do it. They'll remember.

choices.text: Call the whole crew to a vote of confidence
choices.result: The articles say a pirate captain serves at the crew's pleasure.

unrest_broken_promise.title: A broken promise
unrest_broken_promise.text: A month has gone by. The crew remember what you promised.

choices.text: There was no money
choices.result: Nobody believes you twice.

unrest_weapons_missing.title: Weapons missing
unrest_weapons_missing.text: The armourer reports cutlasses and two brace of pistols gone from the arms chest. Someone is getting ready.

choices.text: Search the ship from stem to stern
choices.result: The weapons turn up in a sea chest, and so does the name of the man who owns it.

choices.text: Lock the arms chest and double the officers' watch
choices.result: Your officers sleep with pistols under their pillows.

choices.text: Speak to the whole crew, plainly
choices.result: You talk about the voyage, the plunder to come, and the rope that waits for mutineers. Some of them think again.
choices.fail_result: Fine words, but they don't land.

unrest_confront.title: The ringleader
unrest_confront.text: You know who has been stirring the crew: {leader}. The question is what to do about it.

choices.text: Hang {leader} from the yardarm
choices.result: Without a head, the plot dies. The crew will fear you, and some will hate you for it.

choices.text: Maroon {leader} on the next cay
choices.result: A pistol, a bottle of water, and the horizon.

choices.text: Put {leader} ashore at the next port
choices.result: Quietly done. The plotters have lost their voice.

choices.text: Buy {leader} off with a bigger share
choices.result: Money talks. For now, {leader} is on your side.

unrest_black_spot.title: The black spot
unrest_black_spot.text: {leader} walks up to you on the quarterdeck in front of the whole crew and presses a scrap of paper into your hand, blackened on one side with soot. The black spot: a summons to stand down, or else.

choices.text: Laugh at it, and draw your sword
choices.result: Steel comes out all over the deck.

choices.text: Call a vote of the whole crew
choices.result: Let every hand decide.

choices.text: Buy them off: shares and silver
choices.result: Expensive, but the spot goes over the side.

choices.text: Stand down
choices.result: You hand {leader} your sword. The crew will choose a new captain.

mutiny_breaks_out.title: Mutiny!
mutiny_breaks_out.text: Shouts and a pistol shot on the main deck. The mutineers have broken open the arms chest and are coming aft for you.

choices.text: Fight
choices.result: You and whoever stands with you meet them at the break of the quarterdeck.

choices.text: Parley
choices.result: A deal: a bigger share, a fairer ship, and no hangings. The pistols go back in the chest.

choices.text: Surrender the ship
choices.result: You're bundled into the jolly boat. The ship sails on without you.

crew_vote_course.title: The crew want a say
crew_vote_course.text: By the articles, the crew can call a council on any great matter, and they're calling one now. They want more say in where the ship goes and what she hunts.

choices.text: Hold the council and abide by it
choices.result: Loud, long and drunken, but they feel heard.

choices.text: Put your captaincy to the vote
choices.result: If they want a new captain, let them say so.

choices.text: The captain decides at sea. That's in the articles too
choices.result: Grudging nods.

sickness_spreading.title: The surgeon's report
sickness_spreading.text: Your surgeon reports more of the crew down sick every day. Fresh food and rest ashore would do more than any physic.

choices.text: Make for the nearest port
choices.result: The men are glad of it. Set a course for land.

choices.text: Give the sick double rations and keep going
choices.result: It helps a little.

choices.text: No time. They'll mend or they won't
choices.result: The healthy hands look at the sick and wonder if they're next.
